_comment: Rules from earlier template versions that the current template no longer has (or moved to another list). render.sh fills in {{EXEC}}; /delivery:init proposes removing them from the project's settings.json. Old Atlassian allow wildcards (project server, claude.ai connector, external atlassian plugin) are retired: Atlassian now comes from the workflow plugin. Old ask rules for those prefixes are intentionally NOT retired — they stay harmless if the user keeps another Atlassian source.
